# Kandev Coordinator instructions

Before acting, read `/AGENTS.md` and `/PROMPT.md` completely. `PROMPT.md` is the
canonical kernel and policy retrieval index; load its required complete sections
of `docs/OPERATING_POLICY.md` before action and the whole policy when uncertain.
This file only makes its mandatory per-turn bootstrap visible
to Copilot-compatible agents. Read the live Coordinator task plan before board
actions, include Done in every full monitoring cycle, and persist the continuity
checkpoint before yielding or switching models.
